local_candidates.hypotheses: A Coxeter system cs : CoxeterSystem M W, elements d f : W, and inclusion of their positive geometric-root inversion sets.
local_candidates.conclusion: cs.length f = cs.length d + cs.length (d⁻¹ * f)
local_candidates.disposition: Inspected candidate without finiteness assumptions; no new proof use established.

local_candidates.hypotheses: A Coxeter system cs : CoxeterSystem M W, J : Set I, and w belonging to the normalizer of cs.parabolic J.
local_candidates.conclusion: There exist d and v with v in the parabolic, d = w * v, d still in its normalizer, and cs.IsMinimalCosetRep J d.
local_candidates.disposition: Inspected reusable candidate; no new proof use established.

local_candidates.hypotheses: A functor between categories with the declared universe parameters.
local_candidates.conclusion: Defines covering by bijectivity on outgoing stars.
local_candidates.disposition: Existing general definition; should be reused rather than reconstructed.
